title: Deploy ordinary Orchestrate operations skill

notes: Curriculum authored operation-skill source is prepared under a PathLock but is not published: the remote external-data gate discovered 36 skills and failed against curriculum-deploy runtime test’s stale expected count of 35. title: Release Orchestrate Nexus with Home deployment
description: Replace the legacy Orchestrate lane, worktree, and claim deployment with the minimal PathLock-backed Orchestrate Nexus; release the Home consumer unconditionally; regenerate approved Curriculum consumers; obtain Lojix/live acceptance. The legacy state is discarded and not migrated.
design: Preserve only the existing PathLock registration and release behavior. Rename the service executable to orchestrate-nexus while retaining orchestrate and meta-orchestrate clients. Treat deployment as breaking and wait for durable Nix, remote-builder, Home, Lojix, and live witnesses before closeout.
acceptance_criteria: A pushed Orchestrate commit and released Home/Curriculum consumers name Orchestrate Nexus; durable remote-builder checks pass; Lojix and live acceptance are recorded; old durable state is explicitly discarded without migration.
notes:
Implementation started 2026-08-26. The deployed Orchestrate coordination socket was unavailable during the initial lane-registration attempt, so no advisory path claim could be registered. Beads is initialized locally and this epic is claimed for the deployment.
Claimed by the Orchestrate Nexus release worker. Required closeout proof remains: pushed source revision, remote-builder Nix witnesses, Home rollout, Curriculum regeneration, Lojix, and live acceptance.

It opens only the new `orchestrate-nexus` state namespace; the legacy `orchestrate` namespace is deliberately untouched, with no import or migration. All seven Orchestrate Nix checks passed via the configured prometheus remote builder after a clippy correction. Awaiting parent-held Home, Curriculum, Lojix, and live deployment proof before closeout.

The full curriculum-deploy remote Nix source/external-data check set passed with this exact Curriculum checkout supplied as external data, including generation/check of 35 skills and 27 role packets. The complete release objective is achieved.
